entries.text: On a tablet the sidebar no longer opens over your work and then jumps away. Pages stay put while they load, so nothing moves under your finger.
Work item lists on a tablet show the full title again. Kanban columns on a phone let the next column peek in, and the calendar marks the days that have work items.
Profile settings, Intake, Notifications and the work item page now fit phone and tablet screens. Typing in a field on an iPhone no longer zooms the page.
Overdue dates, the division dashboard and unread counts keep their red, amber and green in dark mode, with enough contrast to read.
Buttons, menus and dialogs now have names for screen readers and work from the keyboard. An automated accessibility check finds no issues on any of the 31 pages.
Pages open with about 28 percent less code to download, and long chat threads no longer redraw every message on each refresh.
